query:
query GetVideoCardDetails($videoId: ID!, $shouldFetchVideoVariableReplacementQuery: Boolean!, $archived: Boolean, $includeSpaces: Boolean = true) {
  video: getVideo(id: $videoId, archived: $archived) {
    ... on RegularUserVideo {
      __typename
      id
      ...VideoCardFieldsBase
      spaces @include(if: $includeSpaces) {
        ...SpaceRegularUserVideo
        __typename
      }
      variableReplacement @include(if: $shouldFetchVideoVariableReplacementQuery) {
        originalWord
        replacementWord
        __typename
      }
    }
    __typename
  }
}

fragment VideoCardFieldsBase on RegularUserVideo {
  id
  name
  complete
  archived
  createdAt
  s3_id
  totalReactions
  totalComments
  organization_idv2
  currentUserHasWatched
  views {
    id
    total
    __typename
  }
  thumbnails {
    default
    defaultPlay
    default4X3
    ogFull
    full
    fullPlay
    defaultGif
    defaultGifPlay
    animatedPreview
    __typename
  }
  owner {
    first_name
    last_name
    id
    avatars {
      name
      large
      thumb
      isAtlassianMastered
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  processing_information {
    videoUploadValid
    trim_id
    videoUploadMessage
    __typename
  }
  playable_duration
  video_properties {
    thumbnail_is_png
    recording_version
    width
    height
    externalUpload
    __typename
  }
  organization {
    id
    name
    __typename
  }
  owner_id
  current_user_is_owner
  download_enabled
  downloadable
  downloadableBy
  currentUserCanEdit
  isDirectlySharedWithCurrentUser
  tags
  use_gif
  visibility
  is_protected
  privacy
  isCommunityLoom
  folder {
    id
    name
    special_id
    owner_id
    visibility
    owner {
      first_name
      id
      last_name
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  isParentOfPersonalizedCopies
  personalizationType
  videoVariant
  __typename
}

fragment SpaceRegularUserVideo on SpaceRegularUserVideo {
  id
  name
  isArchived
  privacy
  is_primary
  data_age_limit_in_seconds
  __typename
}
